## Game01: subsetting lists

```{r}
campus = jsonlite::fromJSON(
  "https://isa401-find-your-seat.vercel.app/campus.json")

names(campus) #shows named elements within a list, vector, cols in a data frame

fsb= campus$Farmer #saving Farmer named list in FSB
#equivalent: campus[[5]]
fsb$code


#fsb[[8]]$`2`$sections #floors is 8th in named list under fsb, floor 2 is the third under floors named list
```


#Reading Excel File

```{r occupations}
occupation = readxl::read_excel(
  path = "../data/occupation.xlsx",
  sheet = 5, #sheet= "Table 1.4"
  skip = 1
  )
#when you subset in R drops these specific things
#given that they are three, put them in a vector
# notice the "'" after parentheses
#nothing after the comma which means all columns instead of that space -->1.7
occupation = occupation[-c(32,33,34), ]
#alternatively
occupation = occupation[1:31, ]
```


#Reading a JSON file

```{r My friend JSON}

json_url = "https://data.cincinnati-oh.gov/resource/rvmt-pkmq.json?$limit=100"

crashes_json = jsonlite::fromJSON(json_url)
dplyr::glimpse(crashes_json)
```
